card.name: "to" before reporting symptoms instruction
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "and" in counseling sentences, where the second instruction is to report or alert someone. Also a comma before "and" in a list of set terms.

modes.label: Counseling: and to report
modes.description: "to" after "and" in advice to patients or caregivers, leading into report, alert or contact the provider.
modes.example: Advise patients of the characteristic symptoms of heart failure and<< to>> immediately report such symptoms.

modes.label: List before final item
modes.description: A comma before "and" in a list of math concepts.
modes.example: Understand and use the concepts of subset, intersection, union<<,>> and complement of a set.
